name: navish-commander
description: Durable local execution and recoverable parallel worker batches.
long_description: Run user-authorized shell and file work with stable receipts and independently collectable workers. Requires Node.js 22.16+. Optional PTY workers need Python 3.9+. Pipe workers require only Node. Commands run with your operating-system account permissions. This release candidate includes reproducible comparisons with hosted RDC; it is not a hosted ChatGPT connector or an independently certified product.
